nodes.name: Send to Customer
nodes.notes: The recipient is the email address on the order.

nodes.name: Record Sent
nodes.notes: sent_at is the workflow's clock at the moment it records Gmail's acceptance, a second or two after the send attempt. It is not Gmail's own timestamp and it does not prove inbox delivery. When a row is reconciled by hand after a recording failure, sent_at is set to the send attempt time from Build Customer Email (send_attempted_at).

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Sent but not recorded: ' + $('Prepare Approval').first().json.client_name }}
parameters.message:
={{ 'Gmail accepted the email, but the database update failed.

Gmail message ID: ' + $('Send to Customer').first().json.id + '
Order: ' + $('Prepare Approval').first().json.submission_id + '
Version: ' + $('Prepare Approval').first().json.version + '
Plan version ID: ' + $('Prepare Approval').first().json.plan_version_id + '

Do not resend. Reconcile the plan version and order records using this message ID.' }}

parameters.subject: ={{ $('Classify Send Error').first().json.send_status === 'send_failed' ? 'Delivery failed: ' + $('Classify Send Error').first().json.client_name + '\'s plan was not sent' : 'Check Sent folder: ' + $('Classify Send Error').first().json.client_name + '\'s plan may have gone out' }}
parameters.message:
={{ (() => { const c = $('Classify Send Error').first().json; const ids = 'Order: ' + c.submission_id + '
Version: ' + c.version + '
Plan version ID: ' + c.plan_version_id; if (c.send_status === 'send_failed') { const lead = c.error_source === 'fingerprint_mismatch' ? 'The send was stopped before it reached Gmail. The stored PDF is not the PDF that was approved, so nothing was sent.' : c.error_source === 'local_validation' ? 'The send was stopped before it reached Gmail. n8n rejected the recipient address, so nothing was sent.' : 'Gmail rejected the send.'; return lead + '

Error: ' + c.error_message + '
' + ids + '

Resolve the error before authorizing another attempt.'; } return 'Gmail's send result was not confirmed. The email may have been sent.

Customer: ' + c.client_email + '
Subject: ' + c.customer_subject + '
Attempted at: ' + c.send_attempted_at + '
' + ids + '
Error: ' + c.error_message + '

Check Sent mail and reconcile the status before retrying. An immediate missing search result does not confirm failure.'; })() }}

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Not sent: approval timed out for ' + $('Prepare Approval').first().json.client_name }}
parameters.message:
={{ 'The ' + ($('Prepare Approval').first().json.wait_minutes === 2880 ? '48-hour' : $('Prepare Approval').first().json.wait_minutes + '-minute (test setting)') + ' approval window expired. This version was not sent.

Order: ' + $('Prepare Approval').first().json.submission_id + '
Version: ' + $('Prepare Approval').first().json.version + '
Plan version ID: ' + $('Prepare Approval').first().json.plan_version_id + '

Use 'Re-request approval' with this plan version ID to review the existing PDF.' }}
